question: For the customer who made a transaction of exactly 634.8 on '2012-08-25', identify the country of the gas station where the transaction occurred and compute their year-over-year consumption change rate from 2012 to 2013.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    gs."XCL_006" AS country,
    CAST(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END)) 
        AS REAL) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) AS yoy_change_rate
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    gasstations gs ON t."XCL_015" = gs."XCL_004"
JOIN 
    customers c ON t."XCL_013" = c."XCL_001"
JOIN 
    yearmonth ym ON c."XCL_001" = ym."XCL_019"
WHERE 
    t."XCL_011" = '2012-08-25' 
    AND t."XCL_018" = 634.8
    AND SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013');
